info.name: HustleHub+ Part2
info.description:
Part 2 API tests: auth, gigs, bookings/transactions, income, RBAC, validation/sanitisation, error handling, security headers and rate limiting.

Run with Newman: npx newman run "HustleHub+ Part2.postman_collection.json" --insecure
(API needs EXPOSE_TOKEN_IN_BODY=true so tokens can be read from responses.)
Admin tests run only when adminEmail/adminPassword are provided.
Register and booking limiters allow few requests per window, so use a fresh API process (or wait 15 min) for each run.

exec: // Unique accounts per run, plus dates the booking validator accepts.
pm.test("Auth cookie is httpOnly and Secure", () => { const c = pm.response.headers.get("Set-Cookie") || ""; pm.expect(c).to.include("HttpOnly"); pm.expect(c).to.include("Secure"); });
pm.test("Error message is controlled", () => pm.expect(json.error).to.eql("Role must be 'client' or 'freelancer'."));
pm.test("Error message is controlled", () => pm.expect(json.error).to.eql("An account with this email already exists."));
pm.test("No stack trace or internals leaked", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/stack|node_modules|at .*\.js|mongo/i));
pm.test("Error message is controlled", () => pm.expect(json.error).to.eql("Invalid email or password."));

item.name: Create booking A - client (price comes from the gig)

exec: pm.test("Price taken from the database, not the request", () => pm.expect(json.booking.price).to.eql(600));

item.name: Create booking - date in the past

exec: pm.test("Contains own bookings only", () => { pm.expect(json.bookings.map(b => b.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("bookingA")); pm.expect(json.bookings.every(b => b.clientId === pm.collectionVariables.get("clientId"))).to.be.true; });

item.name: My bookings - freelancer sees bookings on their gigs

exec: pm.test("Only bookings on own gigs", () => pm.expect(json.bookings.every(b => b.freelancerId === pm.collectionVariables.get("freelancerId"))).to.be.true);

item.name: My bookings - other freelancer sees none of them

exec: pm.test("No access to others' bookings", () => pm.expect(json.bookings.map(b => b.id)).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("bookingA")));
pm.test("Error message is controlled", () => pm.expect(json.error).to.eql("Booking not found."));

item.name: Status - declined booking cannot be completed

exec: pm.test("Counts only the completed booking (declined/cancelled are refunded)", () => { pm.expect(json.total).to.eql(600); pm.expect(json.paidOut).to.eql(600); pm.expect(json.inProgress).to.eql(0); });

item.name: 08 Admin (skipped unless adminEmail/adminPassword are set)
item.description: These requests need an admin account, which can only be created in the database. Set the collection variables adminEmail and adminPassword (or pass --env-var / --global-var to Newman). Without them every request here is skipped.

exec: pm.test("Includes the registered users", () => { const ids = json.users.map(u => u.id); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("clientId")); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("victimId")); });
pm.test("Error message is controlled", () => pm.expect(json.error).to.eql("You cannot delete your own account."));

item.name: 09 Rate limiting (run last)
item.description: Uses up the client booking allowance and this IP login allowance, so keep it last. The limiters are per IP/user and last 10-15 minutes, so restart the API (or wait) before re-running the whole collection.

item.name: Booking endpoint returns 429 after too many requests

exec: // Fire requests until the booking limiter (10 per 10 minutes per user) trips.

pm.sendRequest({ url, method: "POST", header: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: "Bearer " + token }, body: { mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify({ gigId: "x" }) } }, (err, res) => { if (res && res.code === 429) hit = true; fire(); });
pm.test("Meaningful message", () => pm.expect(json.error).to.eql("Too many booking requests, please wait a few minutes and try again."));

item.name: Login endpoint returns 429 after too many attempts

exec: // Fire failed logins until the login limiter (5 per 15 minutes per IP) trips.
// The earlier folders have already used most of the allowance.

pm.sendRequest({ url, method: "POST", header: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: { mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify({"email":"ratelimit@example.com","password":"WrongPass123"}) } }, (err, res) => { if (res && res.code === 429) hit = true; fire(); });
pm.test("Meaningful message", () => pm.expect(json.error).to.eql("Too many login attempts, please try again in 15 minutes."));
